name: Tata Sons
h1: A holding company reorganisation, run in one place
lede: The proposed merger of TESS and TCE into Tata Sons is a large integration programme with many owners, under close governance scrutiny. Airtable gives it one connected programme layer.
why_h2: Reorganisation, governance and succession at once
why_p: The structural changes proposed at Tata Sons, and the scrutiny around them, reward programmes that are transparent and easy to report on.

signals.title: Proposed reorganisation of Tata Sons
signals.body: Tata Trusts proposed merging Tata Electronics Systems Solutions and Tata Consulting Engineers into Tata Sons so it is neither an NBFC nor a core investment company, avoiding a mandatory listing.
signals.angle: Track every integration workstream, dependency and approval in one programme base with clear owners.
signals.src: Business Standard and Outlook Money, 28 to 29 Sep 2026

signals.title: What the restructuring means for governance
signals.body: Analysis of the proposed restructuring focused on its implications for listing and governance at the group holding company.
signals.angle: Connected status reporting gives boards and stakeholders one current view instead of assembled decks.

signals.title: Leadership succession under discussion
signals.body: Chairman N. Chandrasekaran's current term ends on 20 February 2027, and succession and the relationship with Tata Trusts leadership are under public discussion.
signals.angle: A shared record of decisions, actions and timelines keeps continuity through leadership transitions.
